entries.name: autodb
entries.title: AutoDB
entries.description: SQL workspaces and connections in a card beside the page: run a statement, a selection or a script, with results in AutoDoc's table panel.
entries.author: yongjohnlee80

items: commands: Show or hide the AutoDB card (o on its SPC p card), Run statement or selection (r on its SPC p card), Run a query (:autodb query <sql>), Save the remote note to its server, Run whole script (s on its SPC p card), Connection… (c on its SPC p card), Cancel query (x on its SPC p card)
may run AutoDoc's commands: buffer.new, file.open_path, file.save, plugins.update
a Lua package, asking for nothing

entries.name: jupyter
entries.title: Jupyter
entries.description: Run a lab note's cells (*.lab.md) in a Jupyter kernel, keep their outputs beside the note for AutoDoc to draw, and open an .ipynb as a lab note.
entries.author: yongjohnlee80

items: commands: Run cell or selection (r on its SPC p card), Run all cells (a on its SPC p card), Interrupt kernel (x on its SPC p card), Restart kernel (s on its SPC p card), Choose kernel… (k on its SPC p card), Open an .ipynb as a lab note, Export to .ipynb (e on its SPC p card)
may run AutoDoc's commands: file.open_path, view.redraw
